method.ja: 保存された原題・本文・リンクを全件読解し、必要な参照先を確認した主題別の分類。語義のみのメモは語義として整理し、作者の心理や信条は推定しない。テーマ内候補は計算された類似線や原文リンクとは別の解釈。
method.en: Topic classification through reading every archived title, text and link, supplemented by selected source checks. Lexical notes are classified by recorded meaning, without inferring the author’s psychology or beliefs. Same-topic suggestions are interpretations, separate from computed similarity lines and source links.

aesthetics_representation.description: 形、表象、美の価値、見立て、複製、非対称性を扱うノート。作家や象徴への参照も含み、書かれていない美学的立場は推定しない。
aesthetics_representation.descriptionEn: Notes on form, representation, aesthetic value, analogy, reproduction and dissymmetry, including artist and symbolic references without inferring unstated aesthetic commitments.

architecture_landscape.description: 建築構造、都市構想、離宮、塔、地上絵、文学者の旧宅など、空間や遺構の形。
architecture_landscape.descriptionEn: Spatial and historical forms including architectural structure, urban propositions, villas, towers, geoglyphs and writers’ historic residences.

art_nature_materials.description: 水・霧・石・布などの素材、環境の条件や物の記憶を作品にする参照。
art_nature_materials.descriptionEn: Art references involving water, fog, stone, textiles, environmental conditions and material memory.

astronomy_astrobio.description: 天体、軌道、生命の指標、宇宙開発企業、暦による時間区分への参照。企業名や保存された仮説から未記載の研究成果は推定しない。
astronomy_astrobio.descriptionEn: References to celestial bodies, orbits, signs of life, space ventures and calendar-based timekeeping. Names and recorded hypotheses do not establish unrecorded research results.

audio_analysis.description: 音高推定と音・文章の対応から音を解析・検索するツール。
audio_analysis.descriptionEn: Tools for analysing and retrieving sound through pitch estimation and audio–text correspondence.

audio_hardware.description: 録音、再生、音の制御や振動・騒音の調整を支える物理的な道具。 博物館などの一次資料で機能を確認した電子楽器・録音関連機器。 蓄音機などの録音再生装置とトレブル等の音響調整。
audio_hardware.descriptionEn: Physical tools supporting recording, playback, sound control and management of vibration or noise. Electronic instruments and recording hardware whose functions are identified in primary museum or manufacturer records. Recording and playback devices, including phonographs, and treble adjustment.

bio_physiology.ja: 生理・細胞・身体画像
bio_physiology.description: 細胞間伝達、心筋の機能、生存条件、寛解と、保存された身体の超音波画像。記録の主題を分類し、個人の健康状態や診断は推定しない。
bio_physiology.descriptionEn: Cellular communication, cardiac function, survival conditions, remission and an archived bodily ultrasound image. The grouping classifies recorded subjects without inferring any person’s health status or diagnosis.

biology_ecology.description: 生物、植物、農業、形態、淘汰、共進化、生息域、環境保全への参照。題名だけの場合は対象の識別に留める。
biology_ecology.descriptionEn: References to organisms, plants, agriculture, morphology, selection, coevolution, habitats and conservation. Bare titles support identification of a subject only.

bodily_sensation.description: 色域、多義図形、固有感覚、前庭感覚、音や味の刺激、感受性など、身体と感覚の参照。
bodily_sensation.descriptionEn: References to gamut, ambiguous figures, proprioception, vestibular sensation, auditory and taste stimuli, and sensitivity.

body_dance_media.description: 身体の動きや衣服を、計測・映像・生成モデル・装置と結びつける舞台表現。
body_dance_media.descriptionEn: Performance connecting bodily movement and clothing with sensing, imagery, generative models and devices.

brain_stimulation.description: TMS、tDCS、tACSなど脳活動を外部から刺激する方法への参照。
brain_stimulation.descriptionEn: References to external stimulation of brain activity, including TMS, tDCS and tACS.

change_patience.description: 慣れを変えること、時間と変化、窮地・忍耐・活動・回復を扱う教訓。
change_patience.descriptionEn: Notes and maxims about changing habits, time, adversity, patience, activity and resilience.

cognition_perception.description: 条件付け、認知の偏り、反応時間、映像の文脈、連合記憶、臨界期、生物性の知覚など、知覚と学習を扱う記述。
cognition_perception.descriptionEn: Accounts of conditioning, cognitive biases, response time, image context, associative memory, critical periods and perceived animacy.

color_material_expression.description: 紺・丹・極彩色、雲母の煌めきや半透明性、華やかさ。
color_material_expression.descriptionEn: Dark blue, vermilion, saturated palettes, translucent mica, shimmering surfaces and vivid appearance.

computing_infrastructure.description: 処理装置、半導体、実行環境と、コードや制作の反復を支えるAI開発ツール。
computing_infrastructure.descriptionEn: Processing hardware, semiconductors and runtimes, together with AI development tools supporting iteration of code and creative work.

creative_audio_tools.description: 合成、リズム生成、音源の組合せ、同期、波形や物体の操作を支える制作環境、音声形式、楽器設計や作者への参照。
creative_audio_tools.descriptionEn: References to creative environments, audio formats, instrument design and makers, supporting synthesis, rhythm generation, sound combinations, synchronisation and manipulation of waveforms or objects.

creative_coding.description: 画像処理、グラフィックス、相互作用や動きをコードで組み立てる制作環境。 コードによる生成的映像、音反応、TouchDesigner、作品・教育への参照。
creative_coding.descriptionEn: Coding environments for constructing image processing, graphics, interaction and motion. Code-based generative visuals, audio response, TouchDesigner and related artists and teaching.

cultural_history.description: 宮廷への納入制度、冠物、古代史と妖怪の記録。
cultural_history.descriptionEn: Court suppliers, traditional headwear and records of ancient history and folklore.

data_visualization.description: 移動、関係、身体の動きや感情の記録を点・線・色・層として可視化する。
data_visualization.descriptionEn: Visualising movement, relationships, bodily motion and emotional records through points, lines, colour and layers.

east_asian_aesthetics.description: 気韻、気韻生動、日本的な様式など、東アジアの美術・表現に関わる保存語義。
east_asian_aesthetics.descriptionEn: Recorded meanings concerning vitality in art, qiyun shengdong and Japanese style in East Asian artistic expression.

emotion_vocabulary.description: 衝動、気づき、出会い、驚き、心の動きなど、保存された情緒の語義。性格や心理診断を推定する分類ではない。
emotion_vocabulary.descriptionEn: Recorded meanings concerning impulses, insight, encounters, astonishment and inner experience. These lexical groupings do not infer personality or a psychological diagnosis.

fashion_textiles.description: 衣服の名称や形、布の折れ、ファッションのブランド・作者と、デザインを技術や事業につなぐ活動。
fashion_textiles.descriptionEn: Garment names and forms, textile folds, fashion brands and makers, and design practices connecting creative work with technology or business.

film_animation.ja: 映画・アニメーション
film_animation.description: 映画名、監督、アニメーション作品、具体的な台詞への参照。未確認の動画内容は推定しない。
film_animation.descriptionEn: References to film titles, directors, animation and specific dialogue; unverified video contents are not inferred.

generative_music_ai.description: 学習モデルによる音楽・音声生成、ニューラル音声表現とその演奏利用。
generative_music_ai.descriptionEn: Learning-based music and audio generation, neural audio representations and their use in performance.

geology_stone.description: 岩石の種類や性質、石材としての使用、火山や溶岩地形への参照。
geology_stone.descriptionEn: Rock types and properties, uses of stone materials, volcanoes and lava landscapes.

interactive_art.ja: 参加・相互作用の表現
interactive_art.description: 観客の動作や選択、環境入力で音・映像・空間が変わる作品、身体的な参加を求める美術、集団の動きを操作するゲーム。
interactive_art.descriptionEn: Works where audience movement, choices or environmental input change sound, images or space, artworks inviting embodied participation, and a game manipulating collective movement.

judgment_evaluation.description: 指標、価値判断、功績の評価、早合点、距離や親しさで変わる見え方。
judgment_evaluation.descriptionEn: Measures, judgments of value, recognition of achievement, premature conclusions and evaluation shaped by distance or familiarity.

kinetic_art.description: 機構図集と、機械、自律装置、ねじれや運動が描画・音・行為を生む作品。資料と作品を同一視せず、動きをつくる仕組みから結びつける。
kinetic_art.descriptionEn: Mechanism reference drawings and works where machines, autonomous devices, torsion or motion generate drawing, sound or action. Their connection is through mechanisms of movement, without treating every reference as an artwork.

language_aesthetic_valuation.description: 美しい、優美、荘厳、原始的など、本文に保存された評価や様式の語義。
language_aesthetic_valuation.descriptionEn: Recorded evaluative or stylistic meanings such as exquisite, graceful, majestic and primitive.

language_communication.description: 連絡、別名、略語、接続表現、伝達経路、人工言語。
language_communication.descriptionEn: Contact, alternative names, abbreviations, discourse connectors, transmission and constructed language.

language_history_characters.ja: 文字・比喩・物語語彙
language_history_characters.description: 字書、漢字の構成、詩語、混淆、物語の結末など、言語の形式・表現を扱う記述。
language_history_characters.descriptionEn: Notes on dictionaries, character construction, poetic expressions, blends and narrative endings.

language_logic_conditions.description: 必然・偶然・先行・類似・本質との関係など、保存された辞書的意味による語彙群。理論への賛同は推定しない。
language_logic_conditions.descriptionEn: Lexical notes on necessity, chance, antecedents, resemblance and relevance, grouped by recorded definitions rather than inferred theoretical commitments.

language_ownership_economy.description: 独占、資源の浪費、役得、資産、相互利益などの辞書的語句。
language_ownership_economy.descriptionEn: Lexical notes concerning proprietary rights, wasted resources, perquisites, assets and mutual benefit.

language_quantity_relations.description: 少量、比例、収束など、本文に保存された量と変化の語義。数学的定理は推定しない。
language_quantity_relations.descriptionEn: Recorded lexical meanings concerning small quantities, proportion and convergence, without inferring mathematical theorems.

language_sensory_affect.description: 感受性、柔軟さ、性質、愛情、目立ち方、均衡、平安、恥ずかしさ、記憶などの保存語義。辞書的な意味でまとめ、心理の診断はしない。
language_sensory_affect.descriptionEn: Recorded meanings concerning sensitivity, yielding, disposition, affection, visibility, balance, calm, embarrassment and remembrance, grouped lexically without psychological diagnosis.

language_skill_agency.description: 技巧、器用さ、丁寧さ、自由な行為、挑戦、難しさなど、技能と行為に関わる保存語義・教訓。書き手の資質とは推定しない。
language_skill_agency.descriptionEn: Recorded definitions and maxims concerning virtuosity, dexterity, care, agency, adventure and difficulty, without inferring the writer’s traits.

language_space_relations.description: 分岐、集まり、境界、迂回、旅、近接、遡行などの辞書的意味。
language_space_relations.descriptionEn: Recorded lexical meanings concerning branching, collections, boundaries, detours, travel, adjacency and upstream movement.

learning_practice.description: 学習、模倣、読書、熟達、伝授、知の定着を扱う語義・教訓。書かれている意味を使い、書き手の信条とは断定しない。
learning_practice.descriptionEn: Recorded definitions and maxims on study, imitation, reading, mastery, transmission and consolidation; their contents do not establish the writer’s beliefs.

light_sound_installations.description: 光や影を空間の素材として扱い、音や観客の関わりと結びつける作品。
light_sound_installations.descriptionEn: Works treating light and shadow as spatial materials, sometimes linked with sound or audience involvement.

literature_memory.description: 俳句、東京散策記、夢十夜など、作品名や本文から確認できる文学参照。
literature_memory.descriptionEn: Literary references identifiable from titles or stored text, including haiku, Tokyo walking essays and Ten Nights of Dreams.

machine_learning.ja: 学習モデル・注意機構
machine_learning.description: 入力から対応関係を学ぶツールや対話型AIへの参照。 単語の関連づけを行う注意機構とマルチモーダルモデルの研究。
machine_learning.descriptionEn: References to tools learning mappings from input and to conversational AI. Self-attention between tokens and research on multimodal models.

management_economics.description: 組織の戦略、音楽産業、事業サービスや仕事上の情報管理への参照。 兼業、委譲、会計、相続、裁定、投入と収穫、資源の乏しさ。
management_economics.descriptionEn: References to organisational strategy, the music industry, business services and professional information management. Concurrent roles, delegated authority, accounting, inheritance, arbitrage, marginal returns and scarce resources.

martial_learning.description: 五輪書、カプ・クイアルア、無手勝流など、兵法や身体的修練への参照。記録の比喩や自己流の意味も含め、同じ流派とは解釈しない。
martial_learning.descriptionEn: References to martial strategy and bodily practice, including The Book of Five Rings, Kapu Kuialua and mutekatsu-ryu. Recorded metaphorical and self-taught meanings do not establish a common school.

materials_properties.description: 多孔性、絶縁・断熱・遮音、光を吸収する表面、電池の反応など、材料の性質や利用。
materials_properties.descriptionEn: Material properties and uses, including porosity, electrical, thermal and sound insulation, light-absorbing surfaces and battery reactions.

math_statistics.description: 記号計算、積分、不変量、双対性、曲率、位相、巡回セールスマン問題や探索空間など、数学の構造と計算。
math_statistics.descriptionEn: Mathematical structure and computation, including symbolic calculation, integration, invariants, duality, curvature, topology, the travelling salesman problem and search spaces.

media_art_history.description: 過去の作品・展示記録や音響・映像装置の開発史への参照。 有線と無線の役割の変化など、メディアの技術史・予測を扱う記述。 展示原資料で確認した情報の空間化・対話的インターフェースへの参照。
media_art_history.descriptionEn: References to historical works, exhibition records and development of audiovisual devices. Accounts of changes and forecasts in media technology, including shifts between wired and wireless transmission. References to information spatialization and interactive interfaces documented by exhibition sources.

music_performance.description: 音楽家、楽器を扱う身体技法、音楽学、クラシックなどの音楽史への参照。
music_performance.descriptionEn: References to musicians, bodily techniques for instruments, musicology and histories of Classical and other music.

natural_ecology.description: 蝶、植物、珊瑚、海、保護区域などの明示的対象。タイトルだけの場合は意味を狭く保つ。
natural_ecology.descriptionEn: Explicit subjects such as butterflies, plants, coral, seas and protected habitats; bare titles support only narrow subject identification.

networked_media_art.ja: ウェブ・ネットワーク表現
networked_media_art.description: ウェブ、通信、AI対話、観客からの画像を表現に用いる作品と、オンラインの関係をつくるサービス。サービスを美術作品と同一視せず、ネットワークという媒体から辿る。
networked_media_art.descriptionEn: Works using the web, communication, AI dialogue or audience images, alongside online social services. Their shared medium is a network, without treating a service as an artwork.

neuroaesthetics.description: 快と刺激強度、美的な震え、反復図形の認知研究、音楽能力の発達仮説。保存された仮説や研究の主題を扱い、因果関係は推定しない。
neuroaesthetics.descriptionEn: Pleasure and stimulus intensity, aesthetic chills, cognitive studies of repeating graphics and a recorded hypothesis of musical development. Topics and hypotheses do not establish causal relations.

neuroscience.description: 脳領域、脳画像、神経科学の学習モデルと耳の構造。解剖学的参照と研究ツールを神経・聴覚の領域で読む。
neuroscience.descriptionEn: Brain regions, brain imaging, models applied to neuroscience and ear anatomy, bringing anatomical references and research tools into a neural and auditory region.

philosophy_nature_change.description: 自然、物質の活力、変化、心と物質、夢と自己、快楽や平安、存在、確率の傾向解釈を扱う思想。異なる立場の同一性を主張せず主題でまとめる。
philosophy_nature_change.descriptionEn: Philosophical subjects of nature, vibrant matter, change, mind and matter, dreams and selfhood, pleasure, tranquility, existence and propensity interpretations of probability; grouping by topic does not equate different positions.

physics_dynamics.description: 振動、同期、波、熱・磁場、結晶、密度変化、海水準や河川の潮など、物理現象と変動。保存された物理語彙も含む。
physics_dynamics.descriptionEn: Physical phenomena and change, including oscillation, synchronisation, waves, heat, fields, crystals, density, sea level and tidal bores, alongside recorded physics vocabulary.

places_travel.description: 都市名、飲食店、滞在先や旅行に関わる場所の参照。 道路の分岐、沖への移動、無人地帯、散歩などの具体的な空間。
places_travel.descriptionEn: References to cities, restaurants, accommodation and places connected with travel. Road intersections, movement offshore, unoccupied territory and walking through space.

politics_society.description: マルクス主義、革命、アナキズム、集団の境界、社会思想への参照。人物名は思想への入口として扱い、立場への賛同は推定しない。
politics_society.descriptionEn: References to Marxism, revolutions, anarchism, group boundaries and social thought. A named thinker is an entry point rather than evidence of endorsement.

reasoning_knowledge.description: 意味のある差異、学際性、理性と感性、対立の両立、概念の限界、知と無知、創造性の分類への参照。
reasoning_knowledge.descriptionEn: References to meaningful difference, interdisciplinary thought, reason and feeling, coexistence of opposites, conceptual limits, knowledge and ignorance, and models of creativity.

religion_buddhism.description: 功徳、説法、戒、仏性、仏像、曼荼羅、真言、禅の公案など仏教の概念と実践。
religion_buddhism.descriptionEn: Buddhist concepts and practice, including merit, teaching, precepts, Buddha nature, sculpture, mandalas, mantras and Zen koans.

religion_myth_ritual.description: 信仰、神話、祭礼、宗教と社会、香、祝事、カバラや占術の記録。保存された意味や主題として読み、真偽や帰依は推定しない。
religion_myth_ritual.descriptionEn: Records of belief, mythology, rites, religion in society, incense, celebrations, Kabbalah and divination, read as stored topics without inferring factual validity or adherence.

research_institutions.ja: 研究者・制度・情報管理
research_institutions.description: 研究助成、研究者の所属、事業化支援、大学の機密保持資料。研究を支える人物・制度・情報の環境としてまとめる。
research_institutions.descriptionEn: Research funding, academic affiliations, commercialisation support and university confidentiality materials, grouped as people, institutions and information supporting research.

robotics_autonomy.description: 物体の把持、機械の自律的な判断、ロボティクスの開発や事業への参照。
robotics_autonomy.descriptionEn: References to object manipulation, autonomous machine decisions and robotics development or business.

sensing_fabrication.description: 点群計測、材料を選別する道具、制作設備やハードウェア設計への参照。 協働ロボット、家庭自動化、電磁波を用いた観測装置など、物理世界を動かし観測する技術。 Kinectの後継など、深度情報・身体動作を捉える装置への参照。
sensing_fabrication.descriptionEn: References to point-cloud sensing, material-selection tools, fabrication facilities and hardware design. Technologies that act on or observe the physical world, including collaborative robots, home automation and radar sensing. References to devices capturing depth or bodily movement, including Kinect successors.

social_ethics.description: 協調、共感、他者への依存、節度、善悪、関係修復、多元的共存を扱う記述や語義。政治思想や心理診断の同一性を推定しない。
social_ethics.descriptionEn: Recorded meanings and accounts of coordination, empathy, interdependence, moderation, good and evil, repairing relationships and pluralism, without inferring common political commitments or psychological diagnoses.

sound_composition.description: 作曲、環境音、図形楽譜、選曲、音色と楽器の共鳴、言葉と音程、実験音楽の参照。
sound_composition.descriptionEn: References to composition, environmental sound, graphic notation, selection, timbre and instrument resonance, words and pitch, and experimental music.

spatial_audio.description: 空間ミキシング、方向性のある残響、反響や聴覚を中心とする作品。
spatial_audio.descriptionEn: Spatial mixing, directional reverberation, echoes and works centred on listening in space.

speculative_shinto_cosmology.ja: カタカムナ・神典宇宙観
speculative_shinto_cosmology.description: カタカムナ文字、ウタヒ、カムの世界、神典図説についての保存された記述。歴史的真偽を認定せず、主題の共通性でまとめる。
speculative_shinto_cosmology.descriptionEn: Recorded claims concerning Katakamuna script, Utahi, the world of Kamu and Shinto diagrams, grouped by topic without validating historical claims.

stage_av_technology.ja: 舞台・映像・通信機器
stage_av_technology.description: 舞台の映像再生、照明制御、音声・データ通信、舞台設計とAR表示機器。
stage_av_technology.descriptionEn: Stage video playback, lighting control, audio and data transport, stage design and AR display devices.

statistics_inference.description: 標準偏差、相関係数、分布、順位検定など、統計的な量と推論。
statistics_inference.descriptionEn: Statistical quantities and inference, including standard deviation, correlation, distributions and rank-based tests.

stone_heritage.description: 境界や庭に置かれた石、その用途や歴史的な伝承への参照。
stone_heritage.descriptionEn: References to stones placed at boundaries or in gardens, their uses and historical associations.

traditional_craft.description: 土器、石積み、截金、ハッチングなど、材料を加工し図像や構造をつくる技法。
traditional_craft.descriptionEn: Techniques constructing images or structures through materials, including earthenware, stone masonry, cut gold leaf and hatching.

traditional_performance.description: 能の番組構成、囃子方、民俗舞踊、舞台芸能と石笛などの音具。文献・博物館資料に示された表現や機能でまとめる。
traditional_performance.descriptionEn: Noh program structures, percussion performers, folk dance, stage performance and sound objects such as stone flutes, grouped by documented expression or function.

venues_festivals.description: 音楽や舞台、映像作品を共有する会場、フェスティバルや公募。 再上映の映画館やクラブの資料など、作品が鑑賞される場所のノート。
venues_festivals.descriptionEn: Venues, festivals and open calls for sharing music, performance and visual work. Notes on spaces of reception, including repertory cinemas and club archives.

vocal_expression.descriptionEn: Bird and animal cries, affective vocal expression, warbling song and the baritone register, connected through the production and qualities of voices.

research.finding: 原論文は20名のERP実験。中・高秩序の早期P2差はなく後期P3b潜時に差を報告。ノートの中程度が最も印象を残すという一般化は分類根拠に使わず、神経美学・注意・分類の研究として整理。
research.findingEn: The original 20-participant ERP study reports no early P2 difference between middle and high orderliness but a later P3b latency difference. Classification uses its neuroaesthetics, attention and categorization topic, without treating the note's broader impression claim as established.

research.title: Archived Sonogram note image
research.finding: 保存された参照画像を目視確認し、音のスペクトログラムではなく身体の超音波画像と識別した。画像の診断や来歴は推定しない。
research.findingEn: The archived reference image was inspected visually and identified as bodily ultrasound imaging rather than an audio spectrogram. No diagnosis or image provenance is inferred.
